drift_resolved.description: Spec requires SpaceItemEntity with 20 properties including faviconUrl, description, visitCount, lastVisited, isPinned, pinPosition, localPath, securityBookmark, lastSyncedAt, and isWatching, but the actual SpaceItem entity implementation is missing from the codebase

Spec requires ISpacesRepository interface with 7 methods (getAllSpaces, getSpaceById, searchSpaces, createSpace, updateSpace, deleteSpace, reorderSpaces) but this interface is missing from the codebase
Spec requires Color value object class with fromHex, fromRGB, toRGB, and equals methods, but this implementation is missing from the codebase
Spec requires SpaceEntity interface definition but this is missing from the actual codebase
Spec requires SpaceEvents (SpaceCreatedEvent, SpaceDeletedEvent, SpaceRenamedEvent) but these are missing from the codebase - only SpaceItemEvents are implemented
Spec requires additional domain errors (ConcurrencyError) and the complete DomainError base class, but ConcurrencyError is missing and DomainError implementation is not visible in the codebase
Spec requires DataSanitizer class with sanitizeString, sanitizeUrl, and sanitizeFileName methods, but this is missing from the codebase
Spec requires service interfaces IEventBus and ILogger, but these are missing from the codebase

The actual implementation includes comprehensive unit tests for validators with detailed test cases, but the specification only mentions testing requirements in acceptance criteria without detailing the test structure
